lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: If an angry, aggressive driver follows your vehicle and attempts to force you off the road, where should you drive?

options.text: Drive directly to a police station, hospital emergency entrance, or open public place
Drive straight to your personal home garage and lock the overhead door
Pull down an isolated, dark rural unpaved alleyway to lose the tailing car
Stop on the highway shoulder, exit your car, and confront the angry driver
